title: DCP Dyadic Valuation and Mod-2^k Anchor-Invariance Hierarchy Bridge
claims: tilde_A(v, x_0) == A v (mod 2^k) holds for all x_0 in {0,1}^K iff A_{.,r} == 0 (mod 2^{k-1}) for all r in supp(v).
Exhibits k=1 universal invariance, k=2 50/50 residue splitting on odd active columns, and k=2,3 100% constructive invariance on even/doubly-even active columns.
